title: Local settings surfaces separate HTTP and profile authority
summary: Pin local transport and origin before entering an exact profile capability, and verify cold policy dependencies through real HTTP operations.
reusable_steps: Pin local transport and origin before entering an exact profile capability, and verify cold policy dependencies through real HTTP operations
expected_outcome: A local settings surface must authenticate the direct loopback peer, pin the local Host even for reads, and require same-origin mutations before resolving private settings. Use a fixed-operation facade paired with a revocable exact profile capability and narrow role; preserve outer resource ceilings and nested capability intersection. Admit directory creation separately from content reads or writes. Include the cold write-policy loader and exact product schema/config dependencies, and test role-only denial plus actual policy loading. Compare a profile-bound revision under the same lock as save, apply only dirty fields and explicit unset operations, and preserve drafts on failure. Disable saving until a valid snapshot loads. Cover body-parser errors with a route-scoped authenticated JSON error boundary and no-store responses. Validate save/unset, invalid Host/Origin, stale revisions, malformed/oversized JSON and unknown errors over HTTP in an isolated profile. These are implementation contracts verified by focused tests, real HTTP probes and independent review; extraction was structural and manually curated.
